text: 5.Nxf7, the knight on f7 swoops in to take the pawn and points its teeth at the rook on h8! But look: the queen on g5 already hunts the pawn on g2, and after 5.Nxf7 the pawn on g2 is left an orphan! Black's queen swoops down with 5...Qxg2 and attacks the rook on h1! 5.Bxf7+ would have let the bishop on f7 take the pawn with check, forcing Black to answer the check before anything else!

7.Be2, a quiet bishop step that blocks the check from the queen on e4. Black's knight swoops in with 7...Nf3 and delivers checkmate! The queen on e4 pins the bishop on e2 to the king, so the bishop cannot take the knight on f3. 7.Qe2 blocks the check and attacks the queen on e4, so 7.Be2 was not the only way to block the check!
